description: This file contains the implementation of a generic utility class 'Interner<TKey, TValue>' used to manage a weakly-referenced cache of interned objects, along with constants relevant to the interner. The class is designed to optimize garbage collection and memory usage for frequently allocated objects in the Orleans project.

classes.name: Interner<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: A thread-safe, weakly-referenced object cache designed to optimize garbage collection by reusing objects associated with specific keys, with periodic cleanup to remove dead references.

methods.name: Interner
methods.description: Constructor initializing the interner with an optional initial size and setting up cache cleanup timer.

methods.name: FindOrCreate
methods.description: Retrieves a cached object by key or creates and caches a new one if none exists, using a creator function.

methods.name: FindOrCreate<TState>
methods.description: Retrieves a cached object or creates and caches one with additional state information.

methods.name: InternCacheCleanupTimerCallback
methods.description: Periodic callback to clean up dead weak references from the cache.
